newsitem.title: USA: Tracor subsidiary gets $23 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Tracor subsidiary gets $23 mln contract.

text.p: Tracor Inc's Tracor Aerospace Inc said Wednesday it was awarded a $23 million contract modification to upgrade a flight display system for night vision equipment used on board U.S. Army, U.S. Navy, and U.S. Marine helicopters.
The system is called the AN/AVS-7 Head-Up Display System.

The company said this system enables pilots and copilots, through their night vision goggles, to view the critical information required for safe aircraft operation during day and nighttime flight operations.
Work on this contract will be performed by a team of Tracor Aerospace employees in Austin, Texas, and by employees of Elbit Systems Ltd in Haifa, Israel.
